name: Hermes: a chat agent beside the reader
objective: Add a server-side Hermes Agent chat to the reader (hideable side panel on desktop, drawer on tablet and phone) where a signed-in member of the owning org asks about the document or about selected lines added as context, answered from the document, the knowledge base, the document's code repos (read-only) and the web on Claude Opus 5.5 at medium effort with the operator's key; chats saved per user per document
